Show ONE concept in TWO STATES side by side: left the browse list, right the SAME selected event opened. Canvas 832 x 896 containing two undistorted 390 x 844 mobile app-content viewports at equal scale, separated by a narrow neutral gutter. No phone hardware, device frames, OS status bars, notches, browser chrome, presentation labels, arrows between screens or desktop UI. Each view must read as actual usable phone screen with body text14-16px at native390px scale, touch targets44px. Flat screenshot. Date anchor Oct20 2026 America/Denver; listings fictional Fri Oct23 and SatOct24 2026. Left a small BURQUE header, location Albuquerque, simple 'This weekend' context, then a vertical list of simple event cards spanning the ENTIRE 390px screen width, no outer side margins, no columns. Internal card padding20px; 3 readable cards within viewport. Each card clear title, venue, date/time, price, category, tiny save; approximately200px tall. No hero marketing headline. Right chosen event opened as a FULL VIEWPORT BLEED ordinary USER-SUBMITTED PHOTO, absolutely edge-to-edge from top to bottom, not just upper hero image. Typography OVER the image protected by subtle strong dark scrim, no separate opaque detail sheet. Close circle top-left, save top-right, selected event title, date, venue and price readable toward lower portion; restrained 'Event details ↑' affordance and one action. No giant unrelated illustration. Shared title/date/venue preserve wording and recognizable typography between left card and right expanded state, intended as anchors for real view-transition animation later; this is a static state study, do not print animation technical text. Photography should look like an ordinary phone snap: imperfect framing, mild grain, practical venue lighting, background clutter, believable rather than premium promotional photography. Mature music/comedy/culture audience, not family. No repetitive title wallpaper, feature inventory or made-up metrics. No footer navigation unnecessary icons. This new set is Pocket Nights.
